claim.summary: Over fixed F_p, features U_j with supplied small linear-placeholder certificates for U_j^2-U_j give a full Hilbert-like IPS refutation of sum_j U_j-beta whenever beta avoids residues {0,...,r}. Selector interpolation costs polynomial supplied size plus O(r^2 2^r), at constant added depth. Explicit atom-power reduction supplies polynomial-size constant-depth Booleanity certificates for U_i=1-ML(S_i^(p-1)) when S_i is a sum of squarefree products of atoms whose supports are disjoint after duplicate identification, with atoms variables or disjunction polynomials. Aggregate products preserve this certificate class. This recovers the cited p>=5 knapsack family's advertised unrestricted upper bound with all Boolean corrections; it gives no binary lower-bound progress.
claim.assessment: Working full selector certificate and structured original-variable multilinearization witnesses, passed by one fresh medium reviewer including exact source match and child disposition. All telescoping witnesses and the circuit convention are explicit. Fixed prime is essential to the polynomial size exponent; beta cannot exist in F_p for r>=p-1. No generic multilinearization or hardness of the alternative rank-image family is claimed.
